institutions.description: Institution stats profiles. An institution may have programmes without a stats profile (stats collection is slower); the reverse is not allowed — a stats profile must have institution_id in rankings.json.

programs.description: Expanded (listed, not yet matchable) programmes. matchable is always false here.

sources.description: Registry of every source used by any institution profile or programme in this file. Same shape as data/schemas/source.json.

traceability.description: One row per sourced fact: every stat value and every fee/requirement/deadline recorded in this file must appear here with its source. Columns mirror data/versions/v2/traceability.csv.
